# NerdWallet

> NerdWallet is a comprehensive personal finance platform providing expert research, comparisons, and tools for credit cards, mortgages, insurance, loans, banking, and investing.

NerdWallet offers independent financial product research with expert reviews, side-by-side comparison tools, and personalized recommendations to help consumers make informed financial decisions. The platform specializes in credit card guidance across multiple reward categories and provides free credit scoring and monitoring services.

## Key Topics

- credit cards
- rewards cards
- cash back
- travel rewards
- balance transfer
- 0% APR
- credit card comparison
- credit score
- sign-up bonuses
- airline cards
- student credit cards
- grocery rewards
- card recommendations
- personal finance
- financial calculators

## Core Credit Card Resources

- [NerdWallet: Finance smarter](https://www.nerdwallet.com): NerdWallet homepage offering financial product research across credit cards, mortgages, insurance, loans, banking, investing.
- [Credit Cards: Browse, Learn and Apply - NerdWallet](https://www.nerdwallet.com/credit-cards): Main credit card hub with card finder, reviews, and comparison tools for rewards, cash back, and balance transfers.
- [Side by Side Credit Card Comparison - NerdWallet](https://www.nerdwallet.com/credit-cards/compare): Interactive credit card comparison tool with side-by-side feature analysis.
- [Take our credit card quiz to get matched today.](https://www.nerdwallet.com/m/credit-cards/analyze/get-started): Credit card matching quiz with approval odds and personalized recommendations.
- [Credit Card Reviews by NerdWallet's Experts - NerdWallet](https://www.nerdwallet.com/credit-cards/reviews): Expert reviews of popular credit cards across all reward categories.
- [Get a Free Credit Score: No Credit Card Needed - NerdWallet](https://www.nerdwallet.com/p/free-credit-score): Free credit score and monitoring service with FICO and VantageScore access.

## Best Credit Cards by Category

- [Best Credit Cards - March 2026 - NerdWallet](https://www.nerdwallet.com/credit-cards/best): Comprehensive guide to best credit cards of 2026 with expert reviews and comparisons across categories.
- [Best Rewards Credit Cards of March 2026 - NerdWallet](https://www.nerdwallet.com/credit-cards/best/rewards): Comprehensive guide to rewards credit cards across cash back, points, and miles.
- [Best Cash Back Credit Cards of March 2026 - NerdWallet](https://www.nerdwallet.com/credit-cards/best/cash-back): Expert guide to cash back credit cards maximizing flexible rewards.
- [Best Travel Credit Cards of March 2026 - NerdWallet](https://www.nerdwallet.com/credit-cards/best/travel): Guide to travel credit cards with rewards optimization and luxury perks.
- [Best Balance Transfer Credit Cards of March 2026 - NerdWallet](https://www.nerdwallet.com/credit-cards/best/balance-transfer): Expert guide to balance transfer cards for debt management and lower APR options.
- [Best 0% APR Credit Cards of March 2026 - NerdWallet](https://www.nerdwallet.com/credit-cards/best/zero-percent): Guide to introductory 0% APR cards with long interest-free periods.
- [Best Credit Card Bonuses for New Cardholders - NerdWallet](https://www.nerdwallet.com/credit-cards/best/bonus-offers): Guide to maximizing credit card sign-up bonuses and new cardholder offers.
- [Best Airline Credit Cards of March 2026 - NerdWallet](https://www.nerdwallet.com/credit-cards/best/airline): Guide to airline credit cards with travel benefits and frequent flyer rewards.
- [Best College Student Credit Cards of March 2026 - NerdWallet](https://www.nerdwallet.com/credit-cards/best/college-student): Guide to student credit cards for building credit history.
- [Best Credit Cards for Groceries of March 2026 - NerdWallet](https://www.nerdwallet.com/credit-cards/best/groceries): Guide to grocery rewards credit cards optimized for food purchases.

## Financial Calculators & Tools

- [Credit Card Balance Transfer Calculator - NerdWallet](https://www.nerdwallet.com/credit-cards/learn/balance-transfer-calculator): Financial calculator for estimating balance transfer savings with 0% APR.
- [Credit Card Interest Calculator - NerdWallet](https://www.nerdwallet.com/credit-cards/learn/credit-card-interest-calculator): Calculator for computing credit card interest charges and APR calculations.
